set.stimulus:
A certain number of persons sit in a straight row facing north. Farida, Ishaan, Jyoti, Meera, Omkar, Tejas and Yamini are among them; the others are not named. They are not necessarily seated in the same order.

1. Only six persons sit between Yamini and Jyoti.

3. Tejas sits sixth from the left end of the row.
4. Only eight persons sit to the right of Yamini.
5. Farida sits fourth to the right of Omkar.
6. Only four persons sit between Tejas and Meera when counted from the left of Tejas.
7. Only one person sits between Meera and Yamini.
8. Neither Yamini nor Omkar is an immediate neighbour of Tejas.

Clue 5 then places Farida.

Third to the right of Meera: Ishaan → Yamini → Omkar — answer **Omkar**.

A certain number of persons sit in a straight row facing north. A, B, C, D, E and F are among them; the others are not named. They are not necessarily seated in the same order.

1. Only three persons sit to the left of C.
2. Only ten persons sit to the right of B.
3. E is not an immediate neighbour of F.
4. Only two persons sit between D and F.
5. Only one person sits between D and E.
6. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the row.
7. Only five persons sit between E and A when counted from the left of E.
8. Only nine persons sit to the right of C.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits second to the left of D?

steps: Start with clues 1, 8 and 2: together they fix C and B.
Clue 6 gives 2 cases — Case 1: F second to the left of B; Case 2: F tenth to the right of B.
Clue 4 cannot be met in Case 1, so it is rejected.
Clue 4 then places D.
Clue 5 splits Case 2 into 2 cases — Case 2a: E second to the left of D; Case 2b: E second to the right of D.
Clue 3 rules out Case 2b — only Case 2a survives.
Clue 7 then places A.
Final arrangement from the left end: 1 unnamed, A, B, C, 3 unnamed, E, 1 unnamed, D, 2 unnamed, F — 13 persons in all.
Second to the left of D: an unnamed person → E — answer **E**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
